description: Defines the Analyzer class used for querying and analyzing build graphs in a build system, including methods for affected items, target filtering, and dependency analysis.

classes.name: Analyzer
classes.description: A class for analyzing build dependency graphs, answering queries about affected items, targets, and dependencies.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Performs analysis based on input JSON string and returns affected targets or items.

methods.name: GetAllAffectedItems
methods.description: Retrieves all items potentially affected by changes in specified source files.

methods.name: InvalidLabels
methods.description: Identifies labels that do not refer to objects in the build graph.

methods.name: TargetsFor
methods.description: Retrieves all targets associated with a set of labels.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a set of targets to include only non-group targets and dependencies of group targets.

methods.name: FilterTarget
methods.description: Recursively filters individual targets, adding non-group targets and dependencies.

methods.name: ItemRefersToFile
methods.description: Checks if an item refers to a specific source file.

methods.name: AddItemsDirectlyReferringToFile
methods.description: Adds items that directly refer to a specific source file to a set.

methods.name: AddAllItemsReferringToItem
methods.description: Adds all items referring to a specific item to a set.

methods.name: WereMainGNFilesModified
methods.description: Checks if main GN files have been modified.
